# NFL Daily — 2026-08-15 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/15: Seahawks sign CB Devon Witherspoon to a four-year, $132M extension with $101M+ guaranteed — the richest deal for a cornerback in NFL history. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49619266/sources-seahawks-cb-witherspoon-agree-4-year-132m-deal)
- 08/15: Steelers DT Keeanu Benton agrees to a four-year, $72M extension ($18M AAV), becoming the highest-paid defensive lineman in franchise history. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49614342/steelers-keeanu-benton-agrees-4-year-72m-extension-sources-say)
- 08/14: Falcons EDGE James Pearce Jr. suspended eight games without pay for violating the personal conduct policy, stemming from a February domestic-dispute arrest. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49611663/falcons-edge-rusher-james-pearce-suspended-8-games-nfl)
- 08/14: NFL also suspended Bills DT Phidarian Mathis (3 games, substances of abuse), Titans CB Nazeeh Johnson (6 games, PED policy), and Commanders DE Dorance Armstrong (1 game, personal conduct) ahead of Week 1 preseason. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-suspensions-falcons-james-pearce-jr/)
- 08/15: Jets QB Geno Smith scratched from the preseason opener vs. the Buccaneers with a sore ankle, considered day-to-day. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49614843/jets-geno-smith-scratched-vs-bucs-due-sore-ankle-day-day)
- 08/14: Seahawks LB DeMarcus Lawrence confirmed his 13th NFL season, 2026, will be his last. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7514291/2026/08/14/demarcus-lawrence-retirement-seahawks-cowboys/)
